result:
Round 286 (FIX-PD-1a, the product-page price fix) **passes**. I checked it in a real browser at 1440×900 and 1280×720, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true. I compared production builds of HEAD `60bfb38` and of A's tree, plus the live dev server. No app source was changed.

**What I confirmed myself:**
- **Scope and tests:** only the 7 allowed files changed, with the same sha256 as A reported. Typecheck passes and the 7 covering test files pass, 124/124. B's claims script gives the same output on a HEAD copy, apart from the expected first line.
- **Mutants:** I re-ran all six on a scratch copy. Each one breaks every test row it is supposed to; a few also break extra rows, which follows from how they work.
- **Door Slams:** the product page now shows **$9.00** (HEAD showed **$0.00**). Both buttons work, and a signed-out Buy Now opens the sign-in window and message as on HEAD.
- **Other products:** all 7 test products show the same price on HEAD and A, including Middle East's Premium version at $99.00. The purchase panel's size and position are identical. Each price on the `/store` cards matches its product page.
- **Product with no price** (my own copy of the test API):
  - The page says "Price unavailable" with no `$`. Add to Cart and Buy Now are greyed out but still reachable with Tab. The line under them reads "Price unavailable — contact us to buy it.", and "contact us" goes to `/support`.
  - Clicking or pressing Enter or Space on either button does nothing: no sign-in window, no message, and no cart, sign-in or order request.
  - The "Complimentary Download" button no longer appears. On HEAD the same product showed $0.00, working buttons and that button.
- **Login protection:** a fresh browser with no login still opens the demo at `/studio-lab`. `/studio/middle-east` still says "Sign in required" and loads no audio. Asking for a Studio access token with no login, or with a fake one, is refused (401 and 403).

**Blocked:** the signed-in and owner views can't be checked in the browser because there is no backend in the cloud. A real-backend 403 is blocked for the same reason. Those states are covered only by unit tests.

**For B** (both existed on HEAD and are in files A was not allowed to touch, so they are not failures of A's work):
- **C-R286-01 (Medium):** a Track with no price shows "Price unavailable" in the panel, but its version card on the same page still says **"Standard $0"**. This is A's reviewer finding (A-R286-REVIEW-TRACK-VERSION-ZERO), now reproduced. The cause is the frozen `createDisplayVersions` falling back to 0. It is the last remaining part of F9.
- **C-R286-02 (Low):** the `/store` card for a product with no price shows **$0** while its page says "Price unavailable". The cause is the same fallback to 0 at `store.tsx:79`. It only shows up with a product that has no price, and none of the standard test products is one.

**Other notes:**
- The status line of doc 214 has a `**სტატუსი:**` prefix before the required text. Doc 213 uses the same format, so I accepted it and said so in the report.
- A used `!` (important) on the greyed-out cursor style because a global `button { cursor:pointer }` rule overrides it otherwise. I accepted it: the cursor measures as "not-allowed" in the browser.
- The full test suite, build, Biome, verify and the smoke test are left to the gate.
- The standard test API is running again on :5199, and my two comparison servers are stopped.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-286.md
- c-round-286.json
- c-round-286/
